notes: Incremental stories added for FEAT-5 covering allowlist enforcement, parsing, error handling, and observability.

change_log.value: Structured Error Handling and Response Contract
Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging

stories.title: Allowlist Enforcement and Rejection Handling
stories.description: Implement strict allowlist checks within the tool router to ensure only registered tools can be invoked, with deterministic rejection responses for any unauthorized tool calls.

stories.title: Anthropic tool_use Block Parsing
stories.description: Build parsing logic to extract tool name and input payload from Anthropic tool_use blocks and normalize them into the internal routing contract.

stories.title: Structured Error Handling and Response Contract
stories.description: Define and implement a consistent error response structure for validation failures, missing fields, and execution errors to ensure predictable downstream handling in the LLM loop.

stories.title: Tool Routing Observability and Debug Logging
stories.description: Integrate debug logging for tool routing decisions, including tool selection, validation outcomes, and execution timing, aligned with existing debug_logger infrastructure.
